speaker: Narrator
text: In the guild hall, Mira signs her apprentice papers under Tobin, the old glassblower.

speaker: Tobin
text: "From today you work my furnace," Tobin says. "And your debt to me is paid, Mira. The roof you mended settles it."

speaker: Mira
text: "Then I owe you nothing," Mira says. "Esk and I will run the night kiln together, as partners."

speaker: Wren
text: Wren watches a porter named Dov sweep the floor without a word to anyone.
